session_1.speaker: Caroline
session_1.text: Hey Mel! Good to see you! How have you been?

session_1.speaker: Melanie
session_1.text: Hey Caroline! Good to see you! I'm swamped with the kids & work. What's up with you? Anything new?

session_1.speaker: Caroline
session_1.text: I went to a LGBTQ support group yesterday and it was so powerful.

session_1.speaker: Melanie
session_1.text: Wow, that's cool, Caroline! What happened that was so awesome? Did you hear any inspiring stories?

session_1.speaker: Caroline
session_1.blip_caption: a photo of a dog walking past a wall with a painting of a woman
session_1.text: The transgender stories were so inspiring! I was so happy and thankful for all the support.

session_1.speaker: Melanie
session_1.text: Wow, love that painting! So cool you found such a helpful group. What's it done for you?

session_1.speaker: Caroline
session_1.text: The support group has made me feel accepted and given me courage to embrace myself.

session_1.speaker: Melanie
session_1.text: That's really cool. You've got guts. What now?

session_1.speaker: Caroline
session_1.text: Gonna continue my edu and check out career options, which is pretty exciting!

session_1.speaker: Melanie
session_1.text: Wow, Caroline! What kinda jobs are you thinkin' of? Anything that stands out?

session_1.speaker: Caroline
session_1.text: I'm keen on counseling or working in mental health - I'd love to support those with similar issues.

session_1.speaker: Melanie
session_1.blip_caption: a photo of a painting of a sunset over a lake
session_1.text: You'd be a great counselor! Your empathy and understanding will really help the people you work with. By the way, take a look at this.

session_1.speaker: Caroline
session_1.text: Thanks, Melanie! That's really sweet. Is this your own painting?

session_1.speaker: Melanie
session_1.text: Yeah, I painted that lake sunrise last year! It's special to me.

session_1.speaker: Caroline
session_1.text: Wow, Melanie! The colors really blend nicely. Painting looks like a great outlet for expressing yourself.

session_1.speaker: Melanie
session_1.text: Thanks, Caroline! Painting's a fun way to express my feelings and get creative. It's a great way to relax after a long day.

session_1.speaker: Caroline
session_1.text: Totally agree, Mel. Relaxing and expressing ourselves is key. Well, I'm off to go do some research.

session_1.speaker: Melanie
session_1.text: Yep, Caroline. Taking care of ourselves is vital. I'm off to go swimming with the kids. Talk to you soon!

session_2.speaker: Gina
session_2.text: Hey Jon! Good to see you. What's up? Anything new?

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.text: Hey Gina! Good to see you too. Lost my job as a banker yesterday, so I'm gonna take a shot at starting my own business.

session_2.speaker: Gina
session_2.text: Sorry about your job Jon, but starting your own business sounds awesome! Unfortunately, I also lost my job at Door Dash this month. What business are you thinking of?

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.text: Sorry to hear that! I'm starting a dance studio 'cause I'm passionate about dancing and it'd be great to share it with others.

session_2.speaker: Gina
session_2.text: That's cool, Jon! What got you into this biz?

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.text: I've been into dancing since I was a kid and it's been my passion and escape. I wanna start a dance studio so I can teach others the joy that dancing brings me.

session_2.speaker: Gina
session_2.text: Wow Jon, same here! Dance is pretty much my go-to for stress relief. Got any fave styles?

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.text: Cool, Gina! I love all dances, but contemporary is my top pick. It's so expressive and powerful! What's your fave?

session_2.speaker: Gina
session_2.text: Yeah, me too! Contemporary dance is so expressive and graceful - it really speaks to me.

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.text: Wow, great idea! Let's go to a dance class, it'll be so much fun!

session_2.speaker: Gina
session_2.text: Yeah! Let's explore some new dance moves. We should plan a dance session soon!

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.text: Yeah definitely! Wanna see my moves next Fri? Can't wait!

session_2.speaker: Gina
session_2.text: Sounds great, Jon! Next Friday works. Let's boogie!

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.blip_caption: a photography of a man in a suit is performing a dance
session_2.query: dancing on stage performance dance competition last year
session_2.text: Wow, I'm excited too! This is gonna be great!

session_2.speaker: Gina
session_2.text: Wow! What did you get?

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.text: Woah, that pic's from when my dance crew took home first in a local comp last year. It was amazing up on that stage! I'm super keen to spread that intensity with other peeps. Gina, you ever been in any dance comps or shows?

session_2.speaker: Gina
session_2.blip_caption: a photography of a couple of people standing next to each other
session_2.text: I used to compete in a few dance competitions and shows - my fav memory was when my team won first place at a regionals at age fifteen. It was an awesome feeling of accomplishment!

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.text: Wow! Winning first place is amazing! What dance were you doing?

session_2.speaker: Gina
session_2.blip_caption: a photo of a large open porch with a fireplace and a view of the water
session_2.text: Thanks! We just did a contemporary piece called "Finding Freedom." It was really emotional and powerful.

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.blip_caption: a photography of a room with a view of the ocean and a few yoga mats
session_2.text: Wow, that must've been great! Check my ideal dance studio by the water.

session_2.speaker: Gina
session_2.text: Cool setup! Man, you can't deny that view! Got time to rehearse with a biz and a new store?

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.text: Hopefully, we will find a place like this that will inspire us!

session_2.speaker: Gina
session_2.text: Wow, it looks great! What dances do you practice? Got any projects planned?

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.blip_caption: a photo of a group of dancers in white dresses on a stage
session_2.text: Thanks! I rehearsed with a small group of dancers after work. We do all kinds of dances, from contemporary to hip-hop. We've got some cool projects in the works. Finishing up choreography to perform at a nearby festival next month. Can't wait!

session_2.speaker: Gina
session_2.text: Wow, it looks awesome! Are they yours at the festival? They're so graceful!

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.text: Yeah, they're the ones performing at the festival! They've been practicing hard and will definitely impress with their grace and skill.

session_2.speaker: Gina
session_2.text: Wow, they look great! Can't wait to see them rock the festival. Gonna be awesome!

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.text: Yeah, awesome! Glad to be part of it.

session_3.speaker: John
session_3.blip_caption: a photo of a man sitting on a bed using a laptop
session_3.text: Hey Maria, great to chat again! I joined a service-focused online group last week and it's been an emotional ride. Everyone there is incredible with their own inspiring stories. They've opened my eyes to new perspectives, and I'm feeling a sense of connection and purpose with them.

session_3.speaker: Maria
session_3.text: Wow, John! That's amazing news. It's great to see you finding such a supportive community that is making a difference.

session_3.speaker: John
session_3.text: Thanks, Maria! It's great to have a group of people with the same passion for serving. It's been really inspiring sharing stories, advice, and encouragement.

session_3.speaker: Maria
session_3.blip_caption: a photo of a poster on a table with a santa clause
session_3.text: That's great to hear! It's always inspiring to share thos things with like-minded individuals. By the way, have you had the chance to meet any of them in person?

session_3.speaker: John
session_3.text: We held some events and got to meet some people. We went to a homeless shelter to give out food and supplies. Seeing the smiles on their faces, we knew we made a real difference. We also organized a toy drive for kids in need. It was amazing seeing the community come together to spread some joy.

session_3.speaker: Maria
session_3.text: That sounds great, John. It's nice to see the difference you're making. Do you have any ideas for future projects?

session_3.speaker: John
session_3.text: We're brainstorming some to help underserved communities get access to education, mentorship, job training, and resume building. The goal is to empower individuals in achieving their aspirations.

session_3.speaker: Maria
session_3.text: That's great, John! Empowering individuals through education and mentorship is crucial for helping them reach their goals. Can't wait to see the initiatives you come up with!

session_3.speaker: John
session_3.text: Thanks, Maria! I'm really excited about them too. I believe that providing the right assistance and resources can make a lasting impact.

session_3.speaker: Maria
session_3.text: Yep John, a bit of support can make an amazing change. You're spot on about it, it really is powerful. Keep doing what you're doing, it's really inspiring!

session_3.speaker: John
session_3.text: Thanks, Maria! I really appreciate your support, It means a lot to me. Especially after I failed the military aptitude test recently, I've been feeling a bit stressed out.

session_3.speaker: Maria
session_3.blip_caption: a photo of a sunset over the ocean with a wave coming in
session_3.text: No worries, John. I'm here for you and I got your back. Nature's beauty reminds me to slow down and enjoy the small stuff.

session_3.speaker: John
session_3.text: That's a chill pic! Where did you find it?

session_3.speaker: Maria
session_3.text: I took it at the beach last month. Watching the sunset was so peaceful, it made me feel connected to nature and appreciate life's small moments.

session_3.speaker: John
session_3.text: Wow, nature can be so beautiful! It reminds me of the film camera I had as a kid, I took plenty of beach pics. Thanks for sharing.

session_3.speaker: Maria
session_3.text: Glad you enjoyed it, John! It's amazing how beautiful it can be.

session_3.speaker: John
session_3.blip_caption: a photo of a group of people standing around a field
session_3.text: Yeah, it does. It helps us remember the small joys, especially when life gets busy.

session_4.speaker: Maria
session_4.blip_caption: a photo of a bride and groom walking down the street
session_4.text: Hey John, I haven't talked to you in a while. Last week, my grandma passed away and it's been really hard. I'm trying to stay positive, but it's tough. How're you doing?

session_4.speaker: John
session_4.blip_caption: a photo of a family sitting on the grass with a baby
session_4.text: So sorry to hear about your loss, Maria. I'm here for you if you need anything. I'm doing well, I just had a picnic with the wife and kids.

session_4.speaker: Maria
session_4.text: Thanks for your support, John. How's your family doing? That baby in the pic is adorable! What's their name?

session_4.speaker: John
session_4.text: Thanks, Maria! They're doing great. Our one-year-old is so cute, his name is Kyle!

session_4.speaker: Maria
session_4.blip_caption: a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
session_4.text: Sounds like parenting has been a wonderful experience for you - what has it been like?

session_4.speaker: John
session_4.blip_caption: a photography of two children playing on a playground equipment
session_4.text: It's definitely been a wild ride! It's full of ups and downs, but the love and happiness outweigh it all.

session_4.speaker: Maria
session_4.text: Parenting can be tough but rewarding. Do you take your kid to the park often?

session_4.speaker: John
session_4.blip_caption: a photography of a young girl and a young boy on a swing
session_4.query: park kids playing swings joyful moment
session_4.text: Yeah, we go a few times a week. It's great for family bonding and letting the kids run around. We had a great time last weekend - they really enjoyed the carefree joy.

session_4.speaker: Maria
session_4.text: Looks like a blast! Did everyone get a chance to try it? Glad you're all having a great time!

session_4.speaker: John
session_4.text: Yeah, everyone got a chance to swing. It's always fun coming up with activities for my family to enjoy.

session_4.speaker: Maria
session_4.text: Wow, John, that's amazing! How do you come up with these ideas?

session_4.speaker: John
session_4.text: I just try to find things that we'll have fun with, like a walk or picnic in the park, or finding events in our town and beyond. Just last week, I found a violin concert that we all enjoyed. It's all about making memories together.

session_4.speaker: Maria
session_4.blip_caption: a photo of a picture of a castle in a shadow box
session_4.text: Wow, John, that's great! Making memories together is so valuable. I loved doing something similar with my siblings when I was young - it's amazing how something so simple can make such lasting memories.

session_4.speaker: John
session_4.text: That pic is so cool! It looks like something from a storybook. What gave you the idea for this?

session_4.speaker: Maria
session_4.blip_caption: a photography of a painting of a castle on a hill
session_4.text: Thanks, John! I got the idea from that trip to England a few years ago - I was mesmerized by the castles. I wanted to bring that same magic to my home, like a reminder of the world's beauty. I made a painting too!

session_4.speaker: John
session_4.text: Wow, that looks great! Where in England was it?

session_4.speaker: Maria
session_4.text: It was in London. The architecture there was so captivating that I wanted to recreate some of that charm in my own space. It's a reminder of London's history and grace.

session_4.speaker: John
session_4.blip_caption: a photo of a wooden sign with a flag and eagle
session_4.text: Wow, having symbols of travel memories in our homes is so cool! Last week I retook the aptitude test with some great results, and I feel drawn to serving my country in this way.

session_4.speaker: Maria
session_4.text: Wow, that's really cool! Have you discussed it with anyone yet?

session_4.speaker: John
session_4.text: Yeah, I chatted with my family and friends about it. They've been supportive and understand why I want to volunteer. I'm really proud to have this opportunity!

session_4.speaker: Maria
session_4.blip_caption: a photo of a group of people standing around a table with food
session_4.text: Glad you have a good support system, John. It's been great having people behind me while volunteering at the homeless shelter. Positive influences make a big impact.

session_4.speaker: John
session_4.text: Cool, Maria! You've built some awesome connections and you're making a big impact at the homeless shelter - nice work! How did you manage to do that?

session_4.speaker: Maria
session_4.text: Thanks, John! It took time and effort, but I slowly formed connections by listening and showing compassion. It's all about building trust and forming real relationships.

session_4.speaker: John
session_4.text: Wow, Maria! I see, so that's the key to making a difference.

session_4.speaker: Maria
session_4.text: Yeah, building those real connections and getting people to trust us is key. It's usually the little things, like taking the time to hear what they're saying, that make the biggest impact.

session_4.speaker: John
session_4.blip_caption: a photo of a group of people sitting at a table with plates of food
session_4.text: Yeah, Maria, I agree. That can really make a difference. It's important to make people feel noticed and listened to.

session_5.speaker: Joanna
session_5.text: Hey Nate! Haven't talked in a few days. Crazy things happened to me!

session_5.speaker: Nate
session_5.text: Hi Joanna! Long time no see! What's been going on? You sound excited!

session_5.speaker: Joanna
session_5.blip_caption: a photography of a book with a page of text on it
session_5.text: Woo! I finally finished my first full screenplay and printed it last Friday. I've been working on for a while, such a relief to have it all done!

session_5.speaker: Nate
session_5.text: Wow, that sounds awesome! What's it about? Glad it's all down!

session_5.speaker: Joanna
session_5.text: Thanks, Nate! It's a mix of drama and romance!

session_5.speaker: Nate
session_5.text: Wow, that's amazing! How do you feel now that it's finished? Do you have any new plans for it?

session_5.speaker: Joanna
session_5.text: Woohoo, Nate! I'm feeling a rollercoaster of emotions - relief, excitement, some anxiety - over finishing this project. Now I'm gonna submit it to some film festivals and (hopefully) get producers and directors to check it out. Here's hoping!

session_5.speaker: Nate
session_5.text: Congrats, Joanna! That sounds like a wild experience. Rock on and I hope they love it!

session_5.speaker: Joanna
session_5.text: Thanks Nate! A mix of emotions for sure. Hopefully, it leads to positive feedback and new opportunities.

session_5.speaker: Nate
session_5.blip_caption: a photography of a turtle and a turtleling sitting on a rock
session_5.text: Yeah, for sure. Hoping for the best! I like having some of these little ones around to keep me calm when things are super important and I'm nervous.

session_5.speaker: Joanna
session_5.text: Awww! How long have you had them?

session_5.speaker: Nate
session_5.text: I've had them for 3 years now and they bring me tons of joy!

session_5.speaker: Joanna
session_5.text: They sure lookl like they do! Adorable!

session_5.speaker: Nate
session_5.text: Thanks! The turtles might be small, but both sure have big personalities. I really reccomend having something like these little guys for times of stress.

session_5.speaker: Joanna
session_5.text: Good idea, Nate! I'll think about it and maybe get pets of my own soon if I can find any I'm not allergic to. Have you been up to anything recently?

session_5.speaker: Nate
session_5.text: Yeah actually! I start to hang out with some people outside of my circle at the tournament. They're pretty cool!

session_5.speaker: Joanna
session_5.text: Oh? That sounds sweet! Is it a weird relationship with them being competitors and all?

session_5.speaker: Nate
session_5.text: Oh, kind of. Some people are more competitive then others, so I tend to just stick around the more chill people here.

session_5.speaker: Joanna
session_5.text: That makes sense! Are you gonna cheer them on even if you lose?

session_5.speaker: Nate
session_5.text: Absolutely! I don't expect to win big here, I just like playing for fun!  You mentioned you were allergic to pets earlier, how bad is it?

session_5.speaker: Joanna
session_5.text: Oh, its really bad. My face gets all puffy and itchy when I'm around certain animals, so I've always just stayed away.

session_5.speaker: Nate
session_5.text: Sorry to hear that. Allergies can be tough. What specifically are you allergic to?

session_5.speaker: Joanna
session_5.text: I'm allergic to most reptiles and animals with fur. It can be a bit of a drag, but I find other ways to be happy.

session_5.speaker: Nate
session_5.text: Awesome! There are lots of things that can bring you joy without pets. What else brings you joy?

session_5.speaker: Joanna
session_5.text: Writing and hanging with friends! That way I can express myself through stories, or just have a good time with people.

session_5.speaker: Nate
session_5.text: That's great to hear! Those are both great things. I'm glad to hear you've got other things to help you get through times of axiousness despite not being able to have animals!

session_5.speaker: Joanna
session_5.text: Thanks, Nate! Writing helps me create wild worlds with awesome characters. Plus, it's a great way to express my feelings. I can't imagine life without it.

session_5.speaker: Nate
session_5.text: Wow, Joanna, that sounds amazing! Keep doing what you love!

session_5.speaker: Joanna
session_5.text: Thanks, Nate! I'll definitely keep pursuing my passion for writing. It means a lot.

session_6.speaker: Tim
session_6.text: Hey John! How've you been? Something awesome happened - I'm writing articles about fantasy novels for an online mag. It's so rewarding!

session_6.speaker: John
session_6.text: Hey Tim! Congrats on the opportunity to write about what you're into! How did it happen?

session_6.speaker: Tim
session_6.text: Thanks! I found this opportunity on a fantasy lit forum and thought it'd be perfect since I love fantasy. I shared my ideas with the magazine and they liked them! It's been awesome to spread my love of fantasy.

session_6.speaker: John
session_6.text: Congratulations! That's awesome. What kind of articles have you been writing?

session_6.speaker: Tim
session_6.text: Thanks! I've been writing about different fantasy novels, studying characters, themes, and making book recommendations.

session_6.speaker: John
session_6.text: Awesome! Must be so rewarding to delve into your books and chat about them. Do you have any favorite books you love writing about?

session_6.speaker: Tim
session_6.text: For sure! Harry Potter and Game of Thrones are amazing - I'm totally hooked! I could chat about them forever!

session_6.speaker: John
session_6.blip_caption: a photo of a book with a picture of a person holding a bookmark
session_6.text: Oh yeah, I remember you telling me about Harry Potter! I've got a funny story. Anthony and I went to this charity thing and ended up in this intense Harry Potter trivia contest. We did alright, but there was this one super-nerd there that took home this as a prize.

session_6.speaker: Tim
session_6.text: That looks great! The signature is sweet! Have you been reading anything?

session_6.speaker: John
session_6.text: I've been reading this inspiring book, it reminds me to keep dreaming.

session_6.speaker: Tim
session_6.text: Books can really inspire and help us keep our dreams alive. Keep it up!

session_6.speaker: John
session_6.text: Thanks! They really do. I want to keep reaching for new goals.

session_6.speaker: John
session_6.text: Have fun with your writing! Catch you later!

session_6.speaker: Tim
session_6.text: Thanks! I'll enjoy writing them. Take care and talk soon!

session_7.speaker: Audrey
session_7.text: Hey Andrew! Good to see ya! What's been up since we last talked?

session_7.speaker: Andrew
session_7.text: Hey Audrey! So, I started a new job as a Financial Analyst last week - it's been quite a change from my previous job. How about you? Anything interesting happening?

session_7.speaker: Audrey
session_7.text: Congrats on the new job! So I got these new collars and tags for my dogs - so cute!

session_7.speaker: Andrew
session_7.text: Thanks! That sounds cute. Can I see a picture?

session_7.speaker: Audrey
session_7.blip_caption: a photography of two dogs are standing in the grass with their mouths open
session_7.text: Sure! See them with their new collars, cute right?

session_7.speaker: Andrew
session_7.text: Cute little guys! What are their names and how long have you had them?

session_7.speaker: Audrey
session_7.text: I've had them for 3 years! Their names are Pepper, Precious and Panda. I can't live without my little ones!

session_7.speaker: Andrew
session_7.text: That's awesome! Have you always wanted a dog, even with living in the city? Can they still go on adventures?

session_7.speaker: Audrey
session_7.text: Absolutely! They're city dogs and we explore all the time. They love trying out new parks and trails. We go on adventures together very often.

session_7.speaker: Andrew
session_7.text: Wow, sounds like they make life so awesome! Kinda jealous of all those fun outings with them.

session_7.speaker: Audrey
session_7.text: They really do! It's great how much happiness they bring. Do you have any pets?

session_7.speaker: Andrew
session_7.text: No, no pets right now. But I do love animals.

session_7.speaker: Audrey
session_7.text: That's great to hear! Animals are truly amazing. Do you have a favorite animal?

session_7.speaker: Andrew
session_7.text: I've always been awed by birds. Their power to soar and explore new spots is amazing.

session_7.speaker: Audrey
session_7.text: Yeah, birds are amazing! I can imagine it feels incredible to soar and see the world from up high. Do you have a favorite type of bird?

session_7.speaker: Andrew
session_7.blip_caption: a photo of two birds flying in the sky with a sun shining behind them
session_7.text: Eagles have always mesmerized me; they're so strong and graceful!

session_7.speaker: Audrey
session_7.text: Yeah they're beautiful. Do you go bird-watching? It must be awesome to see them up close.

session_7.speaker: Andrew
session_7.text: Haven't specifically gone out for bird-watching, but I do spot them when I hike.

session_7.speaker: Audrey
session_7.text: Nice, spotting pretty birds while hiking must be great. Do you have any favorite hiking spots?

session_7.speaker: Andrew
session_7.text: Fox Hollow is a great trail to hike on weekends; the views are awesome!

session_7.speaker: Audrey
session_7.text: Cool, gonna give it a try. Thanks for the suggestion!

session_7.speaker: Andrew
session_7.text: No problem! Let me know how you like it. Have fun hiking!

session_7.speaker: Audrey
session_7.text: Thanks! I'll let you know. Have a good one!

session_7.speaker: Andrew
session_7.text: Take care and have a good one! See ya!

session_8.speaker: James
session_8.text: Hey John! Been a while since we chatted. Sorry 'bout not getting back sooner. How's it going? Any new games you're into?

session_8.speaker: John
session_8.blip_caption: a photo of a wooden table with a game controller on it
session_8.query: charity gaming tournament friends game controllers
session_8.text: Hey James! No worries, I know you are really busy at work. I'm good, thanks for asking. Oh, I've been organizing something with my friends yesterday - it was cool! Guess what it was, I'll give you a little hint.

session_8.speaker: James
session_8.text: Wow, John, that looks awesome! Is it an icon of a new game?

session_8.speaker: John
session_8.text: Nope, not a new game. We put together a tournament for our favorite game, CS:GO. Lots showed up and we made a bunch of money for charity!

session_8.speaker: James
session_8.text: Wow John, organizing that tournament for charity must have been a ton of effort, but it sounds like it was so worth it!

session_8.speaker: John
session_8.text: Definitely worth it! It took some planning and coordination, but seeing everyone come together for a good cause was so rewarding.

session_8.speaker: James
session_8.text: It must have been great to see the results of that effort. Have you considered organizing more events like that in the future?

session_8.speaker: John
session_8.text: Yeah, for sure! It was awesome and I want to do more events like that. It combines my interests and helps the community. Plus, it's great to get people together for some friendly competition.

session_8.speaker: James
session_8.text: Combining gaming and volunteering is a great idea! So fun and fulfilling. Where did you send the collected money?

session_8.speaker: John
session_8.text: Our main goal was to raise money for a dog shelter, which is not far from the street where I live. And we did it!

session_8.speaker: John
session_8.text: I agree. We still had some money left after helping the shelter, and we decided to use this money to buy groceries and cook some food for the homeless. They were very happy about it.

session_8.speaker: James
session_8.text: Glad you are helping those in need! You are doing a great job John, keep up the good work!

session_8.speaker: John
session_8.text: Thanks for your support, James! I won't stop there, I will do more and more good things!

session_9.speaker: John
session_9.text: Hey James! Hope you're doing great. I've some amazing news - I held a gaming tourney with my buddies last night. We played Fortnite and a few other games. We raised a decent amount for a children's hospital. Combining gaming and a good cause felt awesome!

session_9.speaker: James
session_9.text: Hey John! Awesome job organizing a gaming tournament for a children's hospital! Combining gaming and a good cause - that's really cool! Tell me more about who helped out and what other games were played.

session_9.speaker: John
session_9.text: Thanks! We all pulled together for a great cause. My gaming pals and I also played Overwatch and Apex Legends. Everyone had a blast raising money for the kids' hospital. The atmosphere was awesome and everyone was so competitive. In the end, we raised a good amount. Feels good to use our love of gaming for good!

session_9.speaker: James
session_9.text: Wow, that sounds like a blast! It's great how gaming can bring people together like that. You made a huge difference in the kids' lives! Do you have any photos from the tournament?

session_9.speaker: John
session_9.blip_caption: a photo of a computer screen with a game menu on it
session_9.query: gaming tournament intense match engaged thrilling experience good cause
session_9.text: I got a great shot at the tournament. Check it out! Everyone was so hyped, and it felt great knowing we were playing for a good cause.

session_9.speaker: John
session_9.text: Thanks! I'm glad you enjoyed it. It was a really awesome moment - unforgettable for all of us! What's new with you?

session_9.speaker: James
session_9.text: I actually have something new, Samantha and I have decided to move in together!

session_9.speaker: John
session_9.text: Wow, that's a really big decision! I hope you both have weighed the pros and cons. Where are you going to live?

session_9.speaker: James
session_9.text: Of course, this was a mutual and informed decision. We rented an apartment not far from McGee's bar.

session_9.speaker: John
session_9.text: You love spending time together in this bar, don't you?

session_9.speaker: James
session_9.text: We just love it! I’ll be honest, one of the criteria for our choice of apartment was this particular bar nearby.

session_9.speaker: John
session_9.text: Awesome, James! Excited to hear how it goes. Keep me posted and good luck!

session_9.speaker: James
session_9.text: Thanks, John! I'll be sure to keep you updated. I really appreciate your support. Take care!

session_9.speaker: John
session_9.text: No worries! I'm here for you whenever you need. Stay safe and chat soon!

session_9.speaker: James
session_9.blip_caption: a photo of a man and two dogs running in a field
session_9.text: Thanks! Appreciate your support. Stay safe and talk to you soon!

session_10.speaker: Deborah
session_10.text: Hey Jolene, nice to meet you! How's your week going? Anything fun happened?

session_10.speaker: Jolene
session_10.text: Hi Deb! Good to meet you! Yeah, my week's been busy. I finished an electrical engineering project last week - took a lot of work, but it's done now. Anything fun happening for you?

session_10.speaker: Deborah
session_10.text: Congrats! Last week I visited a place that holds a lot of memories for me. It was my mother`s old house.

session_10.speaker: Jolene
session_10.text: Why does it hold such special memories for you?

session_10.speaker: Deborah
session_10.blip_caption: a photo of a woman in a wheelchair hugging a woman in a wheelchair
session_10.text: It was full of memories, she passed away a few years ago. This is our last photo together.

session_10.speaker: Jolene
session_10.blip_caption: a photo of a room with a bench and a window
session_10.query: serene yoga studio windows natural light
session_10.text: Sorry about your loss, Deb. My mother also passed away last year. This is my room in her house, I also have many memories there. Is there anything special about it you remember?

session_10.speaker: Deborah
session_10.text: My mom's house had a special bench near the window. She loved to sit there every morning and take in the view. I come to sit here sometimes, it helps me stay connected to her.

session_10.speaker: Jolene
session_10.blip_caption: a photo of a heart shaped pendant with a bird on it
session_10.text: Staying connected is super important. Do you have something to remember her by? This pendant reminds me of my mother, she gave it to me in 2010  in Paris.

session_10.speaker: Deborah
session_10.text: Yes, I also have a pendant that reminds me of my mother. And what is special for you about your jewelry?

session_10.speaker: Jolene
session_10.text: It has a special symbol on it that represents freedom for me. It's a nice reminder to go for my goals and not get held back.

session_10.speaker: Deborah
session_10.text: It should really give you strength and energy!

session_10.speaker: Deborah
session_10.text: One of my goals is to keep teaching yoga and supporting my community. I'm passionate about helping people find peace and joy through it.

session_10.speaker: Jolene
session_10.text: What inspired you to go down this route?

session_10.speaker: Deborah
session_10.text: Yoga helped me find peace during a rough time, and now I'm passionate about sharing that with others.

session_10.speaker: Jolene
session_10.text: Looking forward to the next chat!

session_11.speaker: Sam
session_11.text: Hey Evan, good to see you! What's new since we last met? Anything cool happening?

session_11.speaker: Evan
session_11.text: Hey Sam! Good to see you! Yeah, I just got back from a trip with my family in my new Prius.

session_11.speaker: Sam
session_11.blip_caption: a photo of a person's feet on a car dashboard as the sun sets
session_11.text: Wow, not bad, what happened to the old one? Where'd you go, by the way?

session_11.speaker: Evan
session_11.blip_caption: a photo of a lake with rocks and mountains in the background
session_11.text: My old prius broke down, decided to get it repaired and sell it. Glad you asked, we went to Rockies, check it out.

session_11.speaker: Sam
session_11.text: Wow! Looks amazing. When did you get to go there?

session_11.speaker: Evan
session_11.text: We all hiked the trails last week - the views were amazing!

session_11.speaker: Sam
session_11.blip_caption: a photography of a man and a child walking through a forest
session_11.query: hiking trail lush greenery bonding experience
session_11.text: Wow, that's cool. I love hiking, but it's been ages since I've done it. I did this hike with my dad way back when I was ten. Going hiking together was great fun, and really special for us.

session_11.speaker: Evan
session_11.text: Aww, that's cute. How far did you two hike?

session_11.speaker: Sam
session_11.text: We hiked a good distance - quite a feat for me back then. It's definitely a great memory.

session_11.speaker: Evan
session_11.text: What other hobbies have you found for yourself?

session_11.speaker: Sam
session_11.blip_caption: a photo of a person holding a paint set in a store
session_11.text: Nothing so far, but I was thinking about trying painting. Do you have any hobbies you love?

session_11.speaker: Evan
session_11.text: Cool idea, Sam! I love it. Have you tried it before?

session_11.speaker: Sam
session_11.text: Not yet, but I'm keen to give it a go. It looks like a nice way to chill and get creative.

session_11.speaker: Evan
session_11.blip_caption: a photo of a painting of a cactus in the desert
session_11.text: Yep, it's a great stress-buster. I started doing this a few years back.

session_11.speaker: Sam
session_11.text: Wow, that's impressive! How did you get into watercolor painting?

session_11.speaker: Evan
session_11.text: My friend got me into it and gave me some advice, and I was hooked right away!

session_11.speaker: Sam
session_11.text: Wow! I hope I can find something I'm as passionate about as you are with watercolor painting.

session_11.speaker: Evan
session_11.text: You'll find it, just keep trying new things until something sparks your excitement.

session_11.speaker: Sam
session_11.text: Thanks, Evan! I'm excited to try new things, should be fun!

session_11.speaker: Evan
session_11.text: No worries, Sam! Super pumped for you! Let's catch up soon and see how you're enjoying your new hobbies!

session_11.speaker: Sam
session_11.text: Yeah, I'll keep you posted. See you soon!

session_11.speaker: Evan
session_11.text: Take it easy, Evan! Can't wait to see you. Have a good one!

session_12.speaker: Calvin
session_12.text: Hey Dave! Long time no see. I just went to an awesome music thingy in Tokyo - so cool!

session_12.speaker: Dave
session_12.text: Hey Calvin! Great to hear from you. How was the music thingy in Tokyo? See any cool bands?

session_12.speaker: Calvin
session_12.text: Hey Dave! The festival in Tokyo was awesome! Didn't see any bands, but met lots of talented artists and industry people. Totally enriching!

session_12.speaker: Dave
session_12.text: Wow, Calvin, sounds great! What did you learn from it?

session_12.speaker: Calvin
session_12.text: I learned a lot and got some great advice from professionals in the music industry. It was inspiring!

session_12.speaker: Dave
session_12.text: Wow, Calvin! Bet that was inspiring being surrounded by professionals. Did you get any advice from them?

session_12.speaker: Calvin
session_12.text: The producer gave me some advice to stay true to myself and sound unique. It got me thinking about where I want my music to go. It's really motivating!

session_12.speaker: Dave
session_12.text: Wow, Calvin! It's really motivating to see you staying true to yourself. It got me thinking, where do you see your music taking you?

session_12.speaker: Calvin
session_12.text: Thanks, Dave! I'm dreaming of touring the world, performing for different people and connecting with them. I hope my music can reach a global audience and make an impact. I'm also looking forward to my upcoming trip to Boston after I finish the Frank Ocean tour. I've heard that the music scene there is awesome, so I can't wait to check it out!

session_12.speaker: Dave
session_12.blip_caption: a photography of a city skyline with a boat in the water
session_12.text: Sounds like an amazing plan, Cal! I can't wait for your trip to Boston. I'll show you around town and all the cool spots. The music scene there is awesome, with places like Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park. You'll definitely have some great performances there. Count me in for the front row when you're up onstage! Oh, and by the way, check out this pic.

session_12.speaker: Calvin
session_12.text: Wow, Boston looks great! Thanks for the tips. And, awesome pic!

session_12.speaker: Dave
session_12.blip_caption: a photography of a green mustang parked in a field of grass
session_12.text: Last weekend I went to a car show. Classic cars are so charming and the dedication people put into restoring them is amazing. That's why I'm so into auto engineering. Can't wait to show you some when you come to Boston! Oh, almost forgot to send a photo, look at this beautiful car!

session_12.speaker: Calvin
session_12.blip_caption: a photo of a red sports car on display at a show
session_12.text: Wow, Dave, that car looks great! Take a look at my car, I put a lot of work into it. Can't wait to see more when I'm in Boston!

session_12.speaker: Dave
session_12.text: Thanks! It definitely took a lot of work. Have you had a chance to check out Boston apart from the gigs?

session_12.speaker: Calvin
session_12.text: Not yet, been pretty busy with rehearsals and traveling. But I'm looking forward to exploring the city, trying out some delicious food, and visiting the popular attractions. Maybe we can grab a bite together when I'm there?

session_12.speaker: Dave
session_12.text: Definitely, Cal! Let's grab some food and I'll show you my favorite spots in the city. Can't wait to show them to you!

session_12.speaker: Calvin
session_12.text: Sounds great, Dave! Can't wait to try out the food there with you. It'll be fun!

session_12.speaker: Dave
session_12.text: It'll be great, Cal! Can't wait to show you the amazing music and food here. See you soon!
